# SkinRenew Pro Notebook (skinrenewpro.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for SkinRenew Pro, a cosmetic anti-aging night cream (1.04 oz / 29.48 g jar) marketed to support hydration and a more radiant-looking complexion in adults. Named ingredients, no amounts given: rosehip oil, grapeseed and resveratrol, sweet almond extract, shea butter, goji berry, sage leaf extract, aloe vera leaf juice, green tea extract; the base, preservatives and fragrance are not listed on the seller's page. Directions: nightly after cleansing, a pea-sized amount over face and neck; patch test first. Packs: 2 jars $79 each ($158 plus shipping), 3 jars $69 each ($207, free shipping), 6 jars $49 each ($294, free shipping); 60-day money-back guarantee by email, no jars returned per the seller.

IMPORTANT: SkinRenew Pro is a cosmetic, not a treatment for wrinkles, dark spots, eczema, rosacea or any condition; no study of the cream is shown. Cosmetics are not FDA approved. Contains nut-derived ingredients (sweet almond, shea); patch test first. A new or changing dark spot needs a doctor. Daily SPF 30 or higher does more for aging skin than any night cream. Adults 18+; ask a doctor first if pregnant, nursing or with a skin condition.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
